arabic text: AKHIR HUSSAIN MAA HU
english translation text: AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: AMMA BADAN YE SARA TEERO SE AB BHARA HAI\nGORE PE NA ZAMEEN PAR, LASHA MERA PARA HAI
english translation text: MOTHER, THIS BODY IS COMPLETELY FILLED WITH ARROWS\nMY BODY IS NEITHER ON THE HORSE, NOR ON THE GROUND

arabic text: AB SHIMR KI CHURI HAI, GARDEN PE CHAL RAHI HAI,\nAMMA MUJHE SAMBHALO
english translation text: NOW SHIMR’S SWORD IS CUTTING MY NECK\nMOTHER, TAKE CARE OF ME

arabic text: AY MERE PYARE HUSSAIN
english translation text: OH MY BELOVED HUSSAIN

arabic text: KAISE GALE PE TERE, KHANJAR ME CHALTA DEKHUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN\nGARDEN PE TERE RAKH KE,
english translation text: HOW CAN I WATCH THE DAGGER CUTTING YOUR NECK, AFTER ALL I AM A MOTHER\nI’LL PUT MY NECK ON YOURS

arabic text: APNA GALA KATAA LUN,\nAKHIR HUSSAIN MAA HUN
english translation text: AND HAVE MY OWN NECK CUT\nAFTER ALL HUSSAIN, I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: KAISE GALE PE TERE, KHANJAR ME CHALTA DEKHUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: HOW CAN I WATCH THE DAGGER CUTTING YOUR NECK, AFTER ALL I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: CHAKKI KO PEES KAR ME, BACHPAN ME TUJHKO PALA,\nRATON KO JAG KAR ME, JULA TERA JULAYA,
english translation text: PAINSTAKINGLY, I BROUGHT YOU UP IN YOUR CHILDHOOD,\nI STAYED UP AT NIGHT ROCKING YOUR CRADLE,

arabic text: SOWO NA AB ZAMIN PAR, GODI ME AA SULALUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: DON’T SLEEP ON THE GROUND NOW, COME I’LL PUT YOU TO SLEEP IN MY LAP, AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: AKBAR KO APNE KANDHEI(N), PE KISTARHA UTHAYA\nCHOTTI LAHAD MEI ASGHAR, KO KISTARHA SULAYA
english translation text: HOW DID YOU PICK UP AKBAR ON YOUR SHOULDERS?\nIN THE TINY GRAVE, HOW DID YOU PUT ASGHAR TO SLEEP?

arabic text: TUMHARI BEKASI PAR, KAISE NA KHUN BAHAWU, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: AT YOUR LONELINESS, HOW CAN I NOT SHED BLOOD, AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: ZAINAB KI IMETHAA(N) KA, KARBAL SE IBTIDA HAI\nBAZAAR-E-SHAAM-O-KUFA, KA AB BHI MARHALA HAI
english translation text: ZAINAB’S TEST IS AFTER KARBALA\nTHERE IS STILL THE TRIAL OF THE BAZAAR OF SHAAM AND KUFA

arabic text: HAR SIMT SAATH HOGI, WADA YE KAR RAHI HU(N), AKHIR HUSSAIN MAA HU
english translation text: EVERY STEP I’LL BE THERE, I’M MAKING THIS VOW, AFTER ALL I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: JINNO MALAK THE SARE, KOI NA DEKH PAYA,\nTANHA TU REHA GAYA HAI, KOI NAHI SAHARA
english translation text: ALL THE JIN AND ANGELS WERE THERE, NO ONE COULD WATCH\nYOU ARE LEFT ALONE, WITH NO HELPER

arabic text: HAR IK QADAM PE HUN ME, MEI KAISE SAATH CHORU(N), AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: I AM WITH YOU EVERY STEP, HOW CAN I LEAVE YOUR SIDE, AFTER ALL I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: PAMAAL HO NA JAAYE, LAASHA TUMHARA RAN MEI\nMERA JIGAR HAI TUKRE, QUWWAT NAHI BADAN MEI
english translation text: LET NOT YOUR BODY BE TRAMPLED IN THE BATTLEFIELD\nMY HEART BREAKS INTO PIECES, I HAVE NO STRENGTH IN MY BODY

arabic text: TERE BADAN KE TUKDE, KAISE MEI KHUD UTHAAWU(N), AKHIR HUSSAIN MAA(N) HU
english translation text: HOW CAN I PICK UP THE PIECES OF YOUR BODY MYSELF, AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: KAYSE SAMBHAL SAKOGE, GORRE PE MERE BETA,\nTEERON SE BHARGAYA HAI, BETA TUMHARA LASHA,
english translation text: HOW WILL YOU BE ABLE TO CONTROL THE HORSE MY SON\nYOUR BODY IS FILLED WITH ARROWS, MY SON

arabic text: HAR AIK TEER APNE, HATHON SE ME NIKALUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: EVERY ARROW I WILL REMOVE WITH MY HANDS, AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: BARHTA HAI EK ZALIM, HATHON ME LEKE KHANJAR,\nGORE SE AB GIRE HO, SAJDE ME HAI TERA SAR,
english translation text: ONE OF THE ENEMIES IS ADVANCING, WITH A DAGGAR/SWORD IN HIS HAND\nYOU HAVE FALLEN FROM YOUR HORSE, YOUR HEAD IS IN SAJDA

arabic text: SAR TERA KATT NA JAYE, AWO TUMHE CHHUPALUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: LET YOUR HEAD NOT BE CUT, COME LET ME HIDE YOU, AFTER ALL HUSSAIN I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: TERE GALE PE ZALIM, KHANJAR CHALA RAHA HAI\nDARYA LAHU KA TERE, GARDEN SE BEH RAHA HAI
english translation text: ON YOUR NECK THIS OPPRESSOR IS RUNNING HIS SWORD\nLIKE A RIVER YOUR BLOOD IS FLOWING FROM YOUR NECK

arabic text: HASTA HAI TERA QATIL, MEI GHAM SE KAMPTI HU(N)
english translation text: YOUR KILLER IS LAUGHING, I AM TREMBLING IN GRIEF

arabic text: NAWHA THA YE 'TEJANI', MAZLOOM MAA(N) KE LAB PAR\nSUKI HAI TERI GARDAN, AUR SHIMR KA HAI KHANJAR
english translation text: THE NAWHA OF THE TEJANIS, ON THE LIPS OF THE OPPRESSED MOTHER\nYOUR THROAT IS DRY, AND SHIMR HAS A SWORD

arabic text: AB KAISE TERE TAN SE, JAAN KO NIKALTA DEKHUN, AKHIR HUSSAIN MAAN HUN
english translation text: NOW HOW CAN I WATCH YOUR LIFE BEING TAKEN FROM YOUR BODY, AFTER ALL I AM A MOTHER

arabic text: GORE SE JAB GIRE, SHABBIR KHAAK PAR\nHAA(N) TEER SE BHARA, TAN THA LAHU MEI TAR
english translation text: WHEN SHABBIR FELL FROM THE HORSE ONTO THE GROUND\nFULL OF ARROWS, HIS BODY WAS COVERED IN BLOOD

arabic text: BOLA THA SHIMR YE, BAALO(N) KO KHENCH KAR,\nPYAASA TUMHE ZIBHA, KARDUNGA REYT PAR
english translation text: SHIMR SAID, PULLING HIS HAIR\nI’LL SLAUGHTER YOU THIRSTY ON THE SAND

arabic text: AJAAWO MERE LAAL, CHILLAYI FATEMAH\nAY SHIMR ROKLO, KHANJAR JO HAI TERA
english translation text: FATEMA SCREAMED, COME MY SON\nOH SHIMR STOP THIS SWORD OF YOURS

arabic text: ZAHRA SE WO MAGAR, MU APNA PHEYR KAR\nMAZLOOM HALQ PE, USKI PARI NAZAR
english translation text: BUT HE TURNED HIS FACE FROM ZAHRA\nHIS GAZE FELL ON THE OPPRESSED THROAT

arabic text: HAAY HAAY LAHU KI PYAAS, WO SHIMR KA BARHA\nPYAASA GALA HUSSAIN KA KHANJAR SE KAT GAYA
english translation text: OH SHIMR’S THIRST FOR BLOOD INCREASED\nTHE THIRSTY HUSSAIN’S NECK WAS SEVERED WITH THE SWORD
